title: Yoast fields on WooCommerce products can be set through wc/v3 but not wp/v2
symptoms: Product SEO title cannot be set through the core endpoint
cause: The WooCommerce v3 products endpoint accepts arbitrary meta_data, including Yoast keys, with no registration. The core product endpoint does not expose them.
fix: Write product SEO fields through wc/v3 meta_data.
affected: WooCommerce REST API v3 with Yoast SEO Premium, September 2026
